title: simeq: Simulation for Equity, a dynamic microsimulation of BMI, health and economic outcomes
description: SIMEQ is an open-source R package for individual-level, stochastic, open-cohort dynamic microsimulation of adult body mass index (BMI) trajectories and their health and economic consequences, stratified by sex and educational attainment. This release (1.0.1) includes the package (Module I: BMI trajectories; Module II: QALYs and years of life lost; Module III: healthcare costs), the Portuguese reference implementation SIMEQ-PT (v10) analysis workflow and its input-preparation scripts, and a fully synthetic four-wave survey panel with a worked example that runs all three modules end to end without access to survey data. Results from the synthetic data are illustrative only. Portuguese National Health Survey microdata and Human Mortality Database life tables are not included.
